text: "[O God] turn your gaze from him so that he may rest, Until he fulfills his day [on earth] like a hired man.
So man lies down and does not rise [again]. Until the heavens are no longer, The dead will not awake nor be raised from their sleep.
"My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And You cover my wickedness [from Your view].
"But his body [lamenting its decay] grieves in pain over it, And his soul mourns over [the loss of] himself."
